confirmation_candidate_rule.diversity: selector must use at least two distinct arms across scenarios
confirmation_candidate_rule.per_scenario: selected arm must beat each unselected arm in success, or tie success and have mean capped time <= 1.05 * that arm
confirmation_candidate_rule.pooled_success: selector success_rate >= every universal arm direct/fixed/conditional
confirmation_candidate_rule.pooled_time: selector mean capped time <= every universal arm direct/fixed/conditional

lineage_constraint.interpretation: The three-arm hypothesis was motivated by the sealed sequence-106 limitation; no sequence-106 confirmation row may be reused for calibration or tuning in this leaf.

measurement_protocol.deadline: fixed_cap + 1.05 * calibration p90 alternative runtime, numpy quantile method=higher
measurement_protocol.runtime: sum per fold of time.perf_counter_ns around fit+predict

ordering_invariants: Persist and exact-readback harness, environment and this precommit before any workload timing.
Persist/readback all fresh calibration rows before deriving selector snapshot.
Persist/readback selector snapshot before measuring any confirmation seed.
Persist/readback all fresh confirmation rows before exactly one confirmation simulation.
Do not change any rule, threshold, tie order, model, seed or gate after calibration measurement starts; do not retune on confirmation.

public_mechanism_audit.mechanism: Scenario-dependent algorithm-selection/configuration rather than one universally fixed policy.
public_mechanism_audit.source: AutoFolio: An Automatically Configured Algorithm Selector (IJCAI 2017)

public_mechanism_audit.mechanism: Complementary portfolio members can cover different regimes.
public_mechanism_audit.source: Hydra: Automatically Configuring Algorithms for Portfolio-Based Selection (AAAI 2010)

public_mechanism_audit.mechanism: Explicit early runtime capping is useful when evidence justifies abandoning a candidate.

purpose: Fresh independent leaf extending the sealed two-arm calibration selector by adding direct/no-switch as a first-class arm. Choose direct, fixed, or conditional from calibration-only counterfactual policy metrics before confirmation outcomes.

selector_rule.secondary: among equal success rates choose lowest calibration mean capped time
